# End-to-end results (generated by bench/report_e2e.py)

Source: results/e2e/qwen3_8b_fp8.json, 5 stock and 5 plugin runs (interleaved, one process each, GPU lock per run), model Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8, vLLM 0.31.0, torch 2.13.0+cu130, commit 6a2a470be9.
Engine: {"gpu_memory_utilization": 0.8, "max_model_len": 8192, "max_num_batched_tokens": 8192, "max_num_seqs": 128, "enable_prefix_caching": false, "seed": 0}.
stock: VLLM_PLUGINS=lora_filesystem_resolver,lora_hf_hub_resolver; block-FP8 linear kernel selected (vLLM's log, every run): MarlinFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.
plugin: VLLM_PLUGINS=lora_filesystem_resolver,lora_hf_hub_resolver,blockfp8; block-FP8 linear kernel selected (vLLM's log, every run): BlockFp8LinearKernel.
SM clock (nvidia-smi, 1 s samples over all runs, idle phases included): median 2745 MHz, min 210, max 2790.

Each run's figure is the median of 3 repetitions; the tables give the median over runs [IQR].

## Outputs vs vLLM's own W8A8 path (triton (extra))

One run with Marlin disabled (VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS); vLLM selected TritonFp8BlockScaledMMKernel. It quantizes activations like the plugin, so it separates the effect of W8A8 from that of the kernel.

| run | identical sequences | tokens before first divergence | position-wise match | max abs logprob diff, greedy (up to divergence) | teacher-forced max | teacher-forced mean | teacher-forced p99 |
